name: the_position_frame_reads_its_diameter_back
why: Z-C21.8, finding M38. geometric_tolerance puts the Ø on a frame through IGtol.SetFrameSymbols (TolDia1), and until library 0.144.0 its answer carried only the argument it had been handed: the frame itself was never asked. IGtol~GetFrameSymbols2.html: «Use this method with IGtol::GetFrameDiameterSymbols, which determines whether diameter symbols are displayed»; IGtol~GetFrameDiameterSymbols.html: «retval [0] = True if the first tolerance value has a diameter symbol». The fix reads that flag back into «diameter_read», refuses a frame whose Ø is not the one asked, and removes that frame from the sheet, saying it is removed only after the frames of the drawing are counted again.
defect_caught: Step 6 asks a position tolerance WITH the Ø: «measurements.diameter_read» must be true, read from the frame. On library 0.144.0 that expectation is RED, because the field does not exist. Step 7 is the other side: a flatness frame WITHOUT the Ø must read false, so a reread that answered true whatever the frame says would be red there.
_the_numbers: Plate 120 x 80 x 10 = 96000 mm3, centred, extruded up from the top plane, the same part and the same datum A as the drawing case of datum, roughness and tolerance frames. swGtolGeomCharSymbol_e (swconst, swGtolGeomCharSymbol_e.html): swGcsPOSITION 23, swGcsFLAT 15.
